products.title: Fundamental Grappling Escapes by William Tackett
products.body:
Willaim Tackett is one of BJJ’s premiere black belt competitors with outstanding performances in ADCC Trials, WNO, Fight to Win Pro, and more to his credit

  • Tackett is a Black Belt under Rodrigo Cobral out of Brazilian Fight Factory in Austin, TX
  • Utilize Tackett’s most reliable blueprints for escape that he’s used at the absolute highest levels of competition to escape the clutches of some of the sport’s most elite athletes
  • Upgrade your escape arsenal with ideas on guard retention and instruction for exiting all of the major positions in BJJ using modern, relevant tactics that will add tremendous value to your ability to leave bad positions in your rearview mirror and get back on the offensive
  • Learn fundamental escape tactics for the first time or sharpen your tools as a higher rank in this all encompassing instructional perfectly suited for BJJ players of all ranks

Make a Clean Getaway From Some of The Worst Situations in BJJ and Get Back On The Attack Featuring Submission Grappling Specialist, Seasoned Competitor, and BJJ Black Belt William Tackett

 

Check out a free sample:

What Will You Learn?

William Tackett has been shocking the BJJ community for years, starting as a minor who began to consistently rake in IBJJF World Titles. The Brazilian Fight Factory Black Belt has continued his streak of success as a black belt competitor, now with multiple prestigious accolades to his credit including multiple WNO, Fight to Win Pro, and Subversiv apparences, and a hard fought path to the finals of the 2021 East Coast ADCC trials where he fell short only to none other than Kade Ruotolo. 

 

With Fundamental Grappling Escapes, you’ll get a firsthand look at how Tackett has managed to remove himself from the controls of some of the most dangerous athletes in modern BJJ competition. With Tacketts guidance, you’ll build a solid fundamental foundation for escaping, that will equip you for dismantling the attacks of even the most aggressive BJJ players and get you back on the attack!

During this 4-part instructional, Tackett will guide you as you explore some of the most innovative and effective ways to escape BJJ’s most dominant positions. You'll get a look at Tackett’s most trusted guard retention secrets, escape multiple variations of side control, upgrade your hip escape mechanics, shed back controls, escape the dreaded body triangle, and much more! 

Tackett has perfected the art of the escape! This has been evident in his ability to remove himself from the clutches of some of the most dangerous and elite BJJ athletes in the competitive scene. Take a page from the book of one of BJJ’s most seasoned competitors and learn the key details and concepts you need to give your escape arsenal a massive upgrade! Whether you’re a BJJ newbie or a veteran practitioner you’ll find great value in Tackett’s instruction and discover the fundamental movements, techniques, and principles you need to build a solid foundation for defending even the most proficient opponents! 

So, What Exactly Do You Get?

products.title: The Great Escapes by Chris Haueter
products.body:
Master Old School Grappling Tricks and Exit Strategies with Dirty Dozen Legend and Combat Base Founder Chris Haueter!

  • Chris Haueter is one of the first 12 practitioners outside of Brazil to receive a black belt in Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu, earning his from Rigan Machado in 1996
  • These escapes are so effective they will work for any rank, age, and body type
  • Explore escapes from side control, mount, back control, and more, with key details and simple old school tips and tricks that will serve you for years to come

Revolutionize Your Defense With Strategies To Dismantle And Escape The Most Common Trouble Spots In BJJ With One Of Jiu-Jitsu’s Most Prolific Figures Who Also Happens To Be An IBJJF World Champion!

 

 

Check out a free sample:

What Will You Learn?

Chris Haueter is an iconic figure in BJJ and as part of the Dirty Dozen and the Founder of Combat Base, he’s created a legacy that will live on in the combat community forever! Known for his old school approach and simple, effective instruction, Haueter is one of the most sought after teachers on the planet. With The Great Escapes, Haueter will provide you with an inside look at some of the most efficient answers to the most commonly encountered bad situations in BJJ. With help from Haueter, his friends, and some coveted old-school secrets, you'll learn how to dismantle dominant positions and make a clean getaway so you can stay in the fight! 

 

 

So, What’s In The Series? 

The series will open with sage advice from Haueter on bad position mindset, so you can learn to respond properly when you're stuck in those unfavorable spots. From there you'll dive right into a series packed with game changing key details on escaping side control, the mount, back control, kesa gatame, and much more! All with signature instruction from Haueter and company that will transform the way you respond to bad situations!

The ability to escape bad positions is among the most important skill sets in all of BJJ and Haueter is a master of the art of survival. Learn the old school secrets and key concepts that the crew at Combat base has used for decades to effectively deconstruct the worst of the worst positions and come away unscathed from match ending scenarios! Size, age, and rank need not apply here. These techniques will work for anyone and add tremendous value to your BJJ toolbox!

products.title: The Pillars of Defense: Turtle & Front Headlock Escapes by Gordon Ryan
products.body:
This is your chance to learn from 3-Time ADCC Champion Gordon Ryan as he shares all his secrets around escaping turtle and front headlocks 

  • Gordon is one of the most detailed and thorough teachers in grappling, with incredible systematic attention to detail.
  • Use peak outs, 4 points, sitting to half guard, and more to get away from front headlocks.
  • Roll to guard and escape from turtle with Gordon’s tips for staying safe and preventing hooks so you can get away from their control while still staying safe from submission threats.
  • These are the same systems that Gordon uses to build his defensive skills as a foundation for his entire game.
  • Watch as Gordon rolls in the gym from these same positions and then breaks down the footage to explain the techniques in action.                                                                                                                              


Build Your Game On A Strong Foundation Of Escapes With These Systems For Escaping Turtle Position And Front Headlocks With ADCC Champion & No-Gi Grappling Superstar Gordon “The King” Ryan

Checkout Sample!

What Will You Learn?

Learn all of the most effective systematic ways to escape from the turtle position and the front headlocks from the best no-gi grappler on Earth, Gordon “The King” Ryan. With hours of content on how you can clear hooks, prevent strangles, stop opponents who are getting behind you, and more on this 8-volume set.

Gordon Ryan is one of the best no-gi grapplers in history, and is still building his legacy with a path of submission success. With 3 ADCC World Championships & an IBJJF World No-Gi Championship, most focus on Gordon’s offense but he believes the true way to build your foundation is improvement on the ability to defend and escape. Now you can see how he approaches this important skill from these common no-gi positions.

Use shoulder rolls, stand ups, 4 point positions, and more to get out from turtle, as Gordon teaches you how to stay safe in what could be a dangerous position as you expose your back. Instead, see all the ways you can use these escapes to start setting up submission threats as you move back to guard and start launching your offense.

Work out of front headlocks with the confidence to not give up your neck or give up your back with Gordon’s advice. Use peek outs, guard pulls, rolls, and more as he explains how to defend yourself in this common problematic position without letting them attack with guillotines, darces, and more.

products.title: The Pillars of Defense: Pin Escapes - Defensive to Offensive Cycles by Gordon Ryan
products.body:
Gordon “The King” Ryan is a multiple-time ADCC champion who is the most dominant and technical no-gi grappler on Earth, and this is your chance to learn his pin escaping!!

  • Get all the highest percentage ways to get out of the mount, side control, knee on belly, north-south, and more in this new nine-part series!
  • Gordon “The King” Ryan is a multiple-time ADCC champion who is the most dominant and technical no-gi grappler on Earth, and this is your chance to learn his pin escaping!
  • See how to turn your defensive cycles into offensive cycles as fast as possible, as Gordon explains how to turn their pins into your counter-attacking opportunities
  • Learn details to make your kipping escapes, side guards, tricep post escapes, and more work against opposition of all levels
  • Gordon’s escaping skill is the basis of his game on the mat - never spending time held down in bad positions gives him the confidence to attack relentlessly
  • See actual rolling footage from the gym as Gordon puts this system into action and then breaks down exactly what he was doing so you can see the techniques in motion


Escape From Every Dominant Pin In Grappling With These Systems & Strategies From The Best No-Gi Grappler On Earth, Gordon “The King” Ryan, As He Shows You His Methods For Turning Defensive Cycles Into Offensive Cycles As Fast As Possible

Check Out Sample!


What Will You Learn?

Don’t spend time stuck and held down in pinning positions anymore - instead build a game with the real technical skill to escape from anywhere with Gordon “The King” Ryan’s new 9-part series on how to get out of all the major pinning positions of grappling. With his help, including live rolling footage with breakdowns, you’ll see how the best grappler on Earth gets out of mount, side control, north south, and more.

Use all the most modern and high-percentage methods to escape, with detailed breakdowns in how each system works from Gordon. Use kipping escapes, elbow escapes, underhooks, and much more as he brings you through how each position is unique and how he has made a career out of never being able to be pinned.

With Gordon’s advice, see how to turn these bad positions into offensive opportunities as fast as possible with his strategies on defensive to offensive cycling. Attack on the escape with leg lock entries, clamp guard, wrestling attacks, and more as he shows how each escape flows seamlessly into an offensive position that you can take advantage of.

Watch these systems in action as Gordon rolls live in the gym and then breaks down each roll - for you to see what he’s doing and hear why he’s doing it. With 9 volumes full of material for you to study, this offers you a full encyclopedia of all the major pins and their variations that you’ll need to escape from, with full explanations from Gordon Ryan on how you should be building your game from any of them.
